name: Diversified Wire & Cable
old_description: Diversified Wire & Cable is a nationally recognized manufacturer of custom fiber optic and copper cable assemblies.
about:
Diversified Wire & Cable is headquartered in Sterling Heights, Michigan, with additional locations in Wisconsin and Gainesville, Georgia. The company was formed through a merger with Great Lakes Wire & Cable to create GLD Group, Inc., a combined resource for networking and cabling communications products and services.

The company manufactures custom fiber optic and copper cable assemblies and operates a wire and cable distribution division that stocks electrical, electronic, voice, data, and security products. Its professional services design team provides wireless network design for Wi‑Fi, microwave, and specialty technologies, distributed antenna system (DAS) design for public‑safety and enterprise cellular customers, and custom cabinet building for IT data centers. Diversified also offers hosted training programs and holds iBwave Wi‑Fi certifications.

Diversified serves public‑safety first responders, enterprise cellular users, IT data centers, and the broader telecommunications and cabling communications market. Its distribution and design services support customers in networking infrastructure, wireless deployments, and data‑center build‑outs.

The company differentiates itself through what it calls “Extreme Service,” a philosophy built on intelligent solutions, total dependability, and a proactive approach. It emphasizes compliance with BICSI, TIA, and IEEE standards, pre‑stocks inventory to meet tight deadlines, and aims to identify cost‑effective alternatives before customers request them.
